controls.title: Define Security Requirements for Software Development
controls.summary: Ensure security requirements for software development are known and maintained.

controls.title: Implement Roles and Responsibilities
controls.summary: Ensure roles and responsibilities for the SDLC are defined and staff are trained.
implementationChecklist: Assign SDLC security roles and training

controls.title: Implement Supporting Toolchains
controls.summary: Use automation to improve consistency and reduce human effort, including security tooling such as static analysis.
implementationChecklist: Integrate security tooling into the toolchain

controls.title: Define and Use Criteria for Software Security Checks
controls.summary: Define criteria for security checks and gather information to determine whether criteria are met.

controls.title: Implement and Maintain Secure Environments
controls.summary: Separate and protect development, build, and test environments.

controls.title: Protect All Forms of Code from Unauthorized Access and Tampering
controls.summary: Store all forms of code securely and control access.

controls.title: Provide a Mechanism for Verifying Software Release Integrity
controls.summary: Give software acquirers a way to verify the integrity and provenance of releases (e.g. signing).
implementationChecklist: Sign releases and publish verification data

controls.title: Archive and Protect Each Software Release
controls.summary: Preserve releases and their provenance data (e.g. SBOMs) to support response and forensics.

controls.title: Design Software to Meet Security Requirements and Mitigate Risks
controls.summary: Design software and perform threat modeling to meet security requirements.

controls.title: Review the Software Design to Verify Compliance
controls.summary: Have qualified reviewers confirm the design meets security requirements and risk information.

controls.title: Reuse Existing, Well-Secured Software
controls.summary: Reuse well-secured components and track their provenance and vulnerabilities.

controls.title: Create Source Code by Adhering to Secure Coding Practices
controls.summary: Write source code following secure coding practices to avoid introducing weaknesses.
evidenceExamples: SAST findings mapped to CWE weaknesses

controls.title: Configure the Compilation, Interpreter, and Build Processes to Improve Security
controls.summary: Enable compiler/build hardening and secure defaults during build.

controls.title: Review and/or Analyze Human-Readable Code
controls.summary: Review and/or analyze human-readable code (e.g. via static analysis) to identify vulnerabilities and verify secure coding compliance.
implementationChecklist: Use static analysis on human-readable code
evidenceExamples: SAST / secrets scan execution and findings

controls.title: Test Executable Code to Identify Vulnerabilities
controls.summary: Test executable code (e.g. via DAST, fuzzing, penetration testing) to identify vulnerabilities.

controls.title: Configure Software to Have Secure Settings by Default
controls.summary: Ship software with secure default settings.

controls.title: Identify and Confirm Vulnerabilities on an Ongoing Basis
controls.summary: Continuously gather information on and confirm potential vulnerabilities in the software.

controls.title: Assess, Prioritize, and Remediate Vulnerabilities
controls.summary: Analyze each vulnerability, assess risk, prioritize, and remediate.
evidenceExamples: Findings with risk score and status

controls.title: Analyze Vulnerabilities to Identify Their Root Causes
controls.summary: Analyze vulnerabilities to identify root causes and reduce future occurrences.
implementationChecklist: Perform root-cause analysis on classes of findings
evidenceExamples: Recurring finding classes as root-cause input
